title: IRDocument
description: SS10 -- one canonical structure. Gherkin, Excel and Jira are renderers over it: no format is second-class, and a fourth output means writing a renderer, not touching the pipeline. A recording produces an array of test cases (SS9.3).

title.description: The capability under test, e.g. 'Order approval'. Renders as the Gherkin Feature name. NOT the tester's objective string: a Feature that repeats the Scenario verbatim reads as machine output, which is the first thing a QA lead judges.

description.description: One or two sentences of context. Renders as the free-text description block under Feature:, which is where Gherkin natively puts this -- a leading # comment is not.

scenarioName.description: The specific case this test exercises, e.g. 'An order over EUR500 is held for manager approval'. Renders as the Scenario name. Falls back to `title` only when composition did not run.

preconditions.description: From segments classified 'setup'. Lift into a Gherkin Background when shared across test cases.

omitted.description: Exploratory/abandoned segments -- shown, not hidden. A verbatim transcript is unusable; silent deletion is untrustworthy.

suggestions.description: SS9.8 -- STRICTLY QUARANTINED. Never rendered as steps, never exported as test cases, always labelled unverified.

warnings.description: Unresolved fidelity flags and critic findings. Never collapsed by default in the UI.

text.description: Intent, not mechanics. 'Submits the order' beats 'clicks the blue button'.

role.description: SS9.3 -- what this step does in the narrative. Given/When/Then is a property of the whole scenario, not of one step, so the keyword is derived from this deterministically rather than chosen per step by a model.

eventIds.description: Traceability into the recording. One of the two backlinks that carry the whole trust story (SS10): this one proves the sentence came from the recording.

investigationRef.description: -> StepInvestigation in the trace. Renders as the 'why this step' panel (SS13.3).

selectorHints.description: For later automation. Rendered as Gherkin comments, never in step text.

libraryRef.description: Set when reused from the step library. The library_verbatim validator enforces that the text matches the entry exactly.

escalation.description: A specific question for the human. A first-class outcome, not a failure -- an agent that asks is more useful than one that guesses.

text.description: Prose -- free. 'the confirmation banner appears'. This is what defuses paraphrase thrash: the model is never forced to write stiff sentences to satisfy a string match.

rank.description: Candidate ordering within the step. Two or three where the step genuinely produced more than one checkable outcome, one where only one thing mattered, none where nothing observable happened (SS9.5). Forcing a second candidate onto a step with one obvious outcome manufactures exactly the weak incidental assertion the ranking exists to demote.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: SS3.2 -- the single most important structure in the system. A claim is valid only if its literal appeared in a tool response THIS agent actually received during THIS run.

literal.description: Exact retrieved string, e.g. 'Order confirmed'. Checked character-for-character by evidence_retrieved.

toolCallId.description: The retrieval that produced it, e.g. tc_0447. The second of the two backlinks (SS10): this one proves the agent went and looked. If this id does not resolve in the trace, the assertion is rejected.

shared.description: True when this precondition is common to several test cases and should lift into a Background block.

afterStepId.description: Which step this omission followed, so the UI can place the '3 exploratory actions omitted' marker.

CoverageSuggestion.title: CoverageSuggestion
CoverageSuggestion.description: SS9.8 -- a prompt for the tester, not an artifact. Must never contaminate grounded output.

basedOn.description: Event ids or tool call ids the observation rests on. Unverified is not the same as ungrounded.

BugDetail.title: BugDetail
BugDetail.description: SS14.2 -- present only when kind is 'bug_report'. `expected` and `actual` are subject to the same evidence binding as any assertion: `actual` must quote something the agent retrieved.
